title: Durable workflow with Upstash Workflow
description: Run a minimal multi-step job with retries and a durable sleep on Neon Functions, and store job state in Lakebase Postgres.

environment.name: QSTASH_URL
environment.description: The QStash endpoint URL is in the Quickstart section of the Upstash Console. It depends on the region and may differ from https://qstash.upstash.io. Locally, use the URL that `npx @upstash/qstash-cli dev` prints.

environment.name: QSTASH_TOKEN
environment.description: The QStash token is in the Quickstart section of the Upstash Console and must come from the same region as QSTASH_URL. POST /api/jobs uses it to start workflow runs.

environment.name: QSTASH_CURRENT_SIGNING_KEY
environment.description: The current signing key is in the Quickstart section of the Upstash Console and must come from the same region as QSTASH_URL. The workflow endpoint uses it to verify that requests come from QStash.

environment.name: QSTASH_NEXT_SIGNING_KEY
environment.description: The next signing key is in the Quickstart section of the Upstash Console and must come from the same region as QSTASH_URL. The workflow endpoint uses it to verify requests during key rotation.
